title: Pastillas Frías de Marasquino de Zara (Cold Maraschino Liqueur Pastilles)
description: Prepared with maraschino, gum arabic, and sugar.

ingredients.name: four ounces very white powdered gum arabic

steps: Pound the sugar and pass through a silk sieve into a porcelain vessel
Dissolve the gum separately in hot water
When cold, pour over the sugar which will be further dissolved with good maraschino spirit of Zara
Dust slate slabs with sugar passed through a silk sieve
Drop the paste onto the slates in the shape of small sticks and cut into round pieces
When the slates are full, shake them against the table so the pieces spread and take the form of pastilles
Place in a stove with moderate heat
The next morning turn them with a thin knife to finish drying

title: Patas de Carnero a la Litera (Mutton Feet à la Litera)
description: Prepared with mutton, butter or lard, and broth.
steps: Clean the feet thoroughly by passing them several times through water.
Boil for at least four or five hours.
Fry flour with butter or lard without browning it.
Add a quantity of defatted broth proportionate to the number of feet to be cooked.
Add the feet to the broth after they have been blanched, cleaned, the bone removed, and cooled in fresh water.
Cook for four or five hours at a gentle boil.
Remove from heat and take out of the casserole.
Add new butter, some small onions and finely chopped parsley to the sauce remaining in the casserole.
If the sauce is not thick enough, add a little flour mixed with defatted broth.
Put the feet back in the casserole.
When the sauce is very hot but not boiling, beat in two or three egg yolks. This should be done moments before serving.

ingredients.name: Sour orange juice or lemon juice

steps: After plucking, cleaning, and singeing the duck over flame to remove down, tuck the legs between the thighs and tie with string.

Rub the breast with lemon juice.
Line a casserole with slices of ham and place the duck on top, covering it with more ham slices.
Place everything in a pan to cook; one hour before serving, put it over the fire and let it cook until ready to serve.
Drain, untie, and arrange on a plate.
For the sauce: heat three tablespoons of Spanish sauce in a small pot over the fire with some black pepper and the juice of a sour orange or lemon, with a bit of its peel.
At the first boil, pour the sauce over the duck.

title: Peras Secas (Dried Pears)

For every fifty pears, add one pound of sugar dissolved in four quartillos of water
Once the sugar is dissolved, place the pears in it and let them soak for two hours

steps: Make a syrup with half a pound of sugar, clarify it, strain it, and bring it to the point of hardening in water.

title: Pollo Relleno en Arroz (Stuffed Chicken in Rice)
description: Prepared with chicken, rice, and kidneys.
steps: Empty and prepare the chicken as in the previous article and fill it with a mixture of rooster combs and kidneys (see page 366), bound with egg.

Cover the extremities with ham slices so that the filling does not escape, and thus prepared, place in a casserole with lemon juice, slices of ham below and above, some slices of veal, three onions, two sliced carrots, two cloves, a bay leaf, a little thyme and two large spoonfuls of concentrated broth.
Place the casserole over fire, three-quarters of an hour being sufficient for cooking if it is small.
Pass the broth in which the chicken cooked through a silk sieve, and add one pound of very clean and well-washed rice, adding good broth if needed.
Let the rice boil for a quarter hour and place it to drain on a hair sieve.
Butter a casserole of appropriate size, place in the middle a wheel of dough with rice on top and arrange the chicken so it is not visible, filling the casserole with rice.
One hour before serving, make it take color as with the gâteau of rice (see page 370), placing fire on top of the lid.

At the moment of serving, turn over the rice cake, remove the dough wheel and empty the interior of the cake without disturbing the edges or bottom, putting inside a spoonful of rizzed sauce, mushrooms, the rest of the chicken stew, black pepper and a liaison of three eggs and as much butter as one egg.

title: Ponche de Espuma Nevada de Crema (Punch with Snowy Cream Foam)
description: Prepared with double cream, powdered sugar, and candied orange.

ingredients.name: Four cuartillos of double cream from milk
Half a pound of powdered sugar
A pinch of gum tragacanth, in powder

steps: Pour the double cream, powdered sugar, and powdered gum tragacanth into a stone or earthenware vessel, adding a little candied orange blossom and three drops of bergamot essence
When the sugar has dissolved, crush six pounds of snow and place it in another vessel of the same material with saltpeter
Place the bottom of the vessel containing the cream on the snow to cool it
To make it foam more quickly, beat it with the same instrument used for beating egg whites
As the cream turns to foam, remove it with a skimmer, rake, or comb and pour it into a sieve placed over a basin
If the cream does not foam as much as needed, help it with two egg whites
If there is not enough foam after all has been beaten, take what has passed through the sieve, beat or whip it again, and mix it with the other

These foams are usually placed in large tin or silver goblets made expressly for this; when these are not available, use glass ones placed in tin containers made for this purpose with a grill in the shape of the goblets
Place crushed snow mixed with saltpeter underneath and also spread over the lid of the containers, which should be made like the upper part of a campaign oven with a gutter for water to drain
This precaution is essential to keep the foams fresh, which can be preserved two or three hours before serving

ingredients.name: sugar, very white, ground and sifted

steps: Make clarified sugar syrup with two pounds of sugar and when at point, set aside
Add two pounds of butter, composed with a little clove, cinnamon, sesame seeds, raisins, almonds and pine nuts
In a platter, lay slices of marquesote and pour the compound syrup over them
On top place egg whites beaten with very white sugar, ground and sifted
When they have thickened in such a way that this layer covers the entire sponge cake well and fills the plate, garnish with sesame seeds, raisins, almonds and pine nuts
Cover with a comal with embers so that it browns

steps: Make syrup with one pound of sugar
Mix away from heat another pound of ground walnuts
Return to fire and as soon as the paste becomes quite thick but without allowing it to reach point, remove it
Beat ten egg yolks until they harden, mixing with sifted sugar to taste
In a platter well buttered place a layer with half of the beaten yolks
Place on top another layer of the walnut paste, which is decorated with raisins, almonds, pine nuts, pieces of candied citron, toasted sesame, and cinnamon powder
Cover this layer with the remaining walnut paste, and on top of all pour the remaining half of the beaten yolks from the first layer, sprinkling sesame on top after everything is well flattened

description: Prepared with cheese, raisins, and almonds.

ingredients.name: 9 egg yolks for each pound of ricotta

steps: Beat the ricotta with sifted sugar to taste and mix in raisins, almonds, walnut pieces, pine nuts, and toasted sesame

Beat so it thickens a little and pour into a dish
Weigh the resulting paste to add 9 well-beaten egg yolks for each pound of ricotta
Add ground biscuits in the necessary quantity to give it body
Pour into a dish greased with butter
Stir in all directions so the dessert flattens and evens out
Grease with butter on top and set it to set and brown at two gentle heats

title: Puchas Comunes (Common Puchas - Ring-Shaped Biscuits)
description: A biscuit made with egg yolks, brandy, and wheat flour.

ingredients.name: Five ounces of melted and cooled butter
One quarter of refined Spanish brandy, or half a quarter of cane brandy and another half of mescal
One quarter ounce of very white tequesquite powder

steps: Beat sixty-four egg yolks the same way as for mamón and pour into a bowl dusted with very fine flour

Add five ounces of sifted sugar, five ounces of melted and cooled butter, one quarter of refined Spanish brandy or half a quarter of cane brandy and another half of mescal, and one quarter ounce of very white tequesquite powder
Mix everything very quickly so that the dough does not cook, adding flour as necessary so that the dough remains smooth and does not stick to the hands
Once everything is well incorporated, beat it a little and spread it on a table to air it sufficiently so that the puchas can be formed in the desired size, cutting proportioned pieces of dough
Place them on baking sheets, separated from each other, and bake in the oven, which should be somewhat hotter than for mamones, covering the opening immediately
When the puchas burst, remove them, turn them quickly, and put them back in the oven to cook on the other side
Remove them and place them in a basket lined with a cloth where they will be covered until they cool completely, then store for use

title: Puchas de Diamantla (Diamantla Puchas)
description: Prepared with egg whites, egg yolks, and white wine.

ingredients.name: One small glass of white wine
Four pounds of fine wheat flour
Three pounds of ground sugar for glazing

steps: Beat thirty egg whites, letting them rest until they have a thick sediment
Separately and without mixing with them, beat well the thirty yolks with seven ounces of ground sugar and a small glass of white wine, then add seven ounces of butter and a little ground salt
Pour this mixture (not the egg whites) into four pounds of fine flour, beating everything so that the dough remains loose; if it is too loose, add a little more flour and knead until it forms eyes
Form the puchas and immediately drop them into a pot prepared with boiling water, leaving them there until they rise and float on the water
Remove them and place them between two cloths to dry, then put them in the oven where they are kept until their smell is noticed, which is the sign that they are cooked
When removing them, coat them with the sediment of beaten egg whites mixed with three pounds of ground sugar

ingredients.name: twenty-five egg yolks, beaten until hardened

title: Puchas Encaneladas (Cinnamon Pastries)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, wine, and syrup.

ingredients.name: thirty-four egg yolks and three egg whites, beaten separately until stiff, then combined
one ounce melted and cooled butter
one small bowl of good Málaga wine
very thick syrup mixed with abundant cinnamon powder

steps: Mix the flour with the beaten egg yolks and whites
Add the sifted sugar, melted butter, and Málaga wine
Incorporate everything and add more flour if necessary, kneading the dough so it is neither too hard nor too soft
Cut and shape the puchas
Let them air-dry a little
Drop them into boiling water and remove them as soon as they rise to the surface
As they are removed from the water, cover them with napkins or cloths, being careful they do not stick together
Once the water has dried, pat them dry, place them on baking sheets, and bake in the oven
After baking, cover them again with napkins
When cooled, coat them with very thick syrup mixed with abundant cinnamon powder
Return the coated puchas to a warm oven to dry

title: Puchero Español (Spanish Stew)
description: Prepared with veal or mutton, chickpeas, and ham.

ingredients.name: 1 to 2 pounds chickpeas, soaked from the night before
1 good slice of raw lean ham

steps: Add 1 to 2 pounds of veal or mutton to a pot with 1 to 2 pounds of soaked chickpeas in proportion.
Add a good slice of raw lean ham and poultry giblets.
When it boils, skim and add salt.
After boiling for half an hour, remove the necessary broth for the sauce you wish to prepare.
Add the legumes to the stew, which should be boiled separately.
Before everything is well cooked, add a chorizo.
When serving, place the meats in one dish and the legumes in another with tomato or parsley sauce.
For the tomato sauce: split three tomatoes and pass through a sieve, then place in a dish with the reserved broth, adding cumin, salt and vinegar. Let it boil a moment and pour into a sauce boat.

For the parsley sauce: grind very green parsley bound with bread crumbs, and place both in a dish with broth, salt and vinegar, letting it boil a good while and stirring with a wooden spoon until it comes together, then serve.

steps: Take three cuarterones of biscuits and break them into small pieces

Cook with milk, adding it little by little as the bread thickens
When it forms a broth not too thick, remove from heat
Clarify six ounces of bone marrow and add to the pot
Add eight ounces of powdered sugar with fresh butter, some raisins, Malaga wine and four ounces of macaroni
Boil this mixture for twelve minutes, stirring constantly
When at the right point, let it cool in a porcelain dish
Add eight egg yolks and one glass of rum
Mix everything and place in a mold and cook like a rice cake, but over good heat

description: A pudding made with juice, egg white, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: one pound of peeled and ground almonds

steps: Make a syrup with six pounds of sugar, clarified with a straw, the juice of one lemon and one egg white
When at medium point, lower sixty-four egg yolks as for real eggs, and stir with four cuartillos of milk, then add to the syrup
Alternatively, put the sugar in the milk and let it boil on the fire; once cooled, add the yolks and mix one pound of peeled and ground almonds with two pounds of butter
Place a layer of sliced mamón in the dish, another of milk and another of almond mixture with butter, sprinkled well with ground cinnamon
Once the dish is filled in this manner, cover with beaten egg yolks and cook at two gentle fires, testing with a straw if the pudding is well cooked

description: A pudding made with butter, ground almonds, and raisins.

ingredients.name: half a pound of peeled and ground almonds

steps: Sweeten three cuartillos of milk with one pound of sugar and after straining, mix in six ounces of butter, half a pound of peeled and ground almonds, half an ounce of ground cinnamon, eighteen beaten eggs, raisins, pine nuts, pieces of walnuts and enough ground biscuit to form the paste
Once everything is well mixed, pour into a mold greased with butter, not filling it to the top
Place in the oven and cook at two fires, taking care that air does not reach it
When it is set, which is known by testing with a straw that comes out clean, remove and let it cool to turn out of the mold and serve

title: Pudín de Frutas á la Inglesa (English-Style Fruit Pudding)
description: A pudding made with lard, plums, and panocha.
steps: Place one pound of flour on a table with a little salt
Add a little water, four eggs, and half pound of lard
Moisten the dough so that it becomes somewhat firm or tight
Knead and extend with a rolling pin
Arrange it on a napkin coated with butter
In the middle of the dough place fifty Spanish-style plums with half pound of well-mashed panocha, a little cinnamon, and one peeled lemon zest
Wrap the dough in the form of a ball or pellet and tie with threads as tightly as possible to prevent water from penetrating
Place the pudding to boil in a pot or cauldron with boiling water
Leave it in this state for about an hour and a half or a little more
At the moment of serving, drain it, cut the threads, remove the napkin from the paste, and pour it onto a deep plate

title: Pudín de Natillas y Requesón (Custard and Curd Cheese Pudding)
description: A pudding made with custard, curd, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: Two cups well filled with custard
Ten ounces of curd cheese from cow milk

steps: Sweeten the milk on the fire with considerable sugar
Add small strips of cinnamon and let it boil until it thickens
Remove from fire, strain and let cool
Mix three cups of milk with sixteen beaten egg yolks
Add two cups well filled with custard
Add ten ounces of curd cheese from cow milk, twelve hard biscuits and four ounces of clean almonds, all ground
Add raisins, pine nuts, pieces of almond, pieces of walnut, candied citron, and more sugar if necessary
Stir everything with a spoon
If it is too loose add biscuit; if too firm add some beaten egg yolks
Have a small stove ready with much fire and well lit with a comal on top, which should already be hot when the paste is made
Turn the paste and pour it into a pan well coated with butter, so that it does not fill and the paste reaches only halfway up its height
Quickly remove the coals from the stove, arrange the pan, cover it with the hot comal and sufficient fire, and let the pudding cook
Be careful that it does not burn
When a popote comes out clean, you will know it is cooked
Remove and leave until the next day
The next day, bring it near the heat of a small stove to melt the congealed fat so that the pudding detaches from the pan, and place it on a plate to be taken to the table

Mix these ingredients and use to fill the roulettes.

Tie very well with thread so they remain tight.

steps: Cut the meat into small pieces and pound them until thin.

Spread a little of this filling on each roulette and roll them up.
Place a casserole on the heat lined with lard and layer the bottom with very thin slices of onion and carrot.
Place the wrapped roulettes on top and let them cook on low heat, covered, with more heat on top than below.
